offence_note: Firearm possession (sawed-off rifle), possession of cocaine and marihuana
sentence_quote: a conditional sentence on the firearms charge of two years less a day, to be followed by probation for two years, is a fit sentence.
systemic_quote: Circumstances beyond his control, some of which no doubt reflect systemic racism, diminish his moral culpability.
note: Conditional sentence replaces 18 months jail; trial ancillary orders remain, unspecified; drug sentence time served.

offence_note: Fraud over $5,000 and breach of trust by MLA expense claims
sentence_quote: I therefore sentence Mr. Hurlburt on the charge of fraud under s. 380(1)(a) of the Criminal Code to a term of imprisonment of 12 months, to be served in the community.
note: Concurrent 12 month conditional sentences with house arrest; restitution already made, amount not shown.

sentence_quote: I sentence you to three years and eight months' incarceration on Count 7 and three years' incarceration on each of Counts 1, 9, 10, 11, and 13 to be served concurrently.
note: Forfeiture order adjourned; victim surcharge not levied; credit 203 days less 30 days for breach.

sentence_quote: While leave to appeal sentence is given, the appeal as to sentence is dismissed.

offence_note: Sexual interference and invitation to sexual touching of daughter

systemic_quote: In my view, the Gladue factors loom very large. The particular circumstances in this case provide a uniquely compelling reason for a reduced sentence.
note: Sexual assault conditionally stayed; s.161 order refused; recommended psychiatric services or healing lodge; victim surcharge waived.

offence_note: Two violent robberies; loaded handgun at probation office
sentence_quote: The sentence was, in our view, within the range for these serious offences which included two violent robberies and showing up at the probation office with a loaded handgun.
note: Sentence length not shown; trial judge weighed remorse and guilty pleas.

sentence_quote: In my view the appropriate period of incarceration in the case at Bar is 18 months. The appropriate period of probation is 36 months.
